expectations.text: Sets a per-organizer workload budget and cites roughly 4-8 hours a month as the published estimate at meetup scale.

expectations.text: Writes role boundaries stating what each role will not absorb, naming over-acceptance - doing the job of multiple people - as the pattern to catch.
